name: Ramdevbaba Solvent Ltd.
summary: Ramdevbaba Solvent Ltd. operates in the agro-industrial sector, primarily focusing on the manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of physically refined rice bran oil. The company offers its rice bran oil under its proprietary brands, "Tulsi" and "Sehat," which are distributed to retailers, wholesalers, and other distributors, mainly across Maharashtra. Additionally, it engages in third-party manufacturing and supplies rice bran oil to various Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) companies, including Mother Dairy Fruit & Vegetable Private Limited, Marico Limited, and Empire Spices and Foods Ltd. As a significant part of its operations, Ramdevbaba Solvent Ltd. also produces de-oiled rice bran, a by-product of rice bran oil extraction, which is marketed for use in cattle, poultry, and fish feed across several Indian states such as Maharashtra, Goa, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu. Other by-products like fatty acid, lecithin, gums, spent earth, and wax are also sold in the open market. The company's manufacturing facilities are located in Mahadula and Brahmapuri, Maharashtra.
